name: Monky D. Luffy
info: Monkey D. Luffy, commonly known as "Straw Hat Luffy" or simply "Straw Hat", is the founder and captain of the Straw Hat Pirates. He pursues the legendary treasure of the late Gol D. Roger in order to become the new Pirate King and reach a further, untold dream (currently known to only his crew, family and closest friends). He believes that being the Pirate King means having the most freedom in the world.

name: Roronoa Zoro
info: Roronoa Zoro, also known as "Pirate Hunter" Zoro, is the master swordsman (剣豪, kengō?) and combatant of the Straw Hat Pirates, one of the Senior Officers of the Straw Hat Grand Fleet, and is publicly recognized as the right-hand man and number two of his crew's captain, Monkey D. Luffy. Formerly a bounty hunter, he is the second member of Luffy's crew and the first to join it, doing so in the Romance Dawn Arc.

name: God Usopp
info: "God" Usopp is the sniper of the Straw Hat Pirates and one of the Senior Officers of the Straw Hat Grand Fleet. He is the fourth member of the crew and the third to join, doing so at the end of the Syrup Village Arc. Although he left the crew during the Water 7 Arc, he rejoined at the end of the Post-Enies Lobby Arc.

name: Vinsmoke Sanji
info: "Black Leg" Sanji is the cook of the Straw Hat Pirates and one of the Senior Officers of the Straw Hat Grand Fleet. He is the fifth member of the crew and the fourth to join, doing so at the end of the Baratie Arc.

name: Nami <3
info: "Cat Burglar" Nami is the navigator of the Straw Hat Pirates and one of the Senior Officers of the Straw Hat Grand Fleet. She is the third member of the crew and the second to join, doing so during the Orange Town Arc. She is the adoptive sister of Nojiko after the two were orphaned and taken in by Bell-mère.

name: Nico Robin
info: Nico Robin, also known by her epithet "Devil Child" and the "Light of the Revolution", is the archaeologist of the Straw Hat Pirates and one of the Senior Officers of the Straw Hat Grand Fleet. She is the seventh member of the crew and the sixth to join, doing so at the end of the Arabasta Arc. She temporarily left the crew during the Water 7 Arc but rejoined during the Enies Lobby Arc.

name: Tony Tony Chopper
info: Tony Tony Chopper, also known as "Cotton Candy Lover" Chopper, is the doctor of the Straw Hat Pirates and one of the Senior Officers of the Straw Hat Grand Fleet. He is the sixth member of the crew and the fifth to join, doing so at the end of the Drum Island Arc. He was temporarily forced to join the Foxy Pirates during the Long Ring Long Land Arc but was quickly returned to Luffy's crew.

name: Franky
info: "Iron Man" Franky is the shipwright of the Straw Hat Pirates and one of the Senior Officers of the Straw Hat Grand Fleet. He is the crew's eighth member and the seventh to join, doing so at the end of the Post-Enies Lobby Arc.

name: Brook
info: "Soul King" Brook is the musician of the Straw Hat Pirates, one of their two swordsmen, and one of the Senior Officers of the Straw Hat Grand Fleet. He is the ninth member of the crew and the eighth to join, doing so at the end of the Thriller Bark Arc.

name: Jinbe
info: "Knight of the Sea" Jinbe is the helmsman of the Straw Hat Pirates and one of the Senior Officers of the Straw Hat Grand Fleet. He is the tenth member of the crew and the ninth to join, doing so during the Wano Country Arc.

name: Kouzuki Momonosuke
status: Ruling Wano Country as the new Shogun
info: Kouzuki Momonosuke is the current shogun of Wano Country. A member of the Kouzuki Family, he is the son of the late daimyo of Kuri Kouzuki Oden and his wife Toki, the grandson of the former shogun Sukiyaki, and the older brother of Hiyori.

name: Carrot
info: Carrot is a rabbit mink, the current ruler of the Mokomo Dukedom, and a former member of the Kingsbirds and Inuarashi Musketeer Squad. She was trained by Pedro, whose will she carries on.

name: Perona
status: Attempting to rescue Moria from Blackbeard’s prison.
info: "Ghost Princess" Perona is a member of the Thriller Bark Pirates and the former commander of the Wild Zombies and Surprise Zombies, prior to Thriller Bark's collapse.

name: Nojiko
info: Nojiko is the owner of a mikan farm in Cocoyasi Village and the adoptive older sister of Nami. They were raised together by their adoptive mother, Bell-mère.

name: Zeff
info: Zeff is the head chef and owner of the Baratie, as well as the adoptive father and mentor of Sanji.

name: Makino
info: Makino is the owner and bartender of Partys Bar in Foosha Village, Monkey D. Luffy's home town. She is also the mother of an unknown child.

name: Laboon
status: wating the straw hats to come back
info: Laboon is an Island Whale the Straw Hat Pirates encounter immediately after entering the Grand Line. He is native to the West Blue and is classified as a Type A creature, "Big Friendly", and at the top of both the size and friendliness scale.

name: Charlotte Katakuri
info: Charlotte Katakuri is the second son and third child of the Charlotte Family and the elder triplet brother of Daifuku and Oven. He is also one of the Three Sweet Commanders of the Big Mom Pirates and serves as Totto Land's Minister of Flour (粉大臣, Kona Daijin?), governing over Komugi Island.

name: Marshall D. Teach
status: Advancing his plans to obtain the One Piece.
info: Marshall D. Teach, most commonly referred to by his epithet "Blackbeard", is the admiral of the Blackbeard Pirates, and one of the Four Emperors that rule over the New World. He is the son of the legendary pirate Rocks D. Xebec and his wife Eris, making him a member of the nearly-extinct Davy Family and a descendant of Davy D. Jones, which is only known to a small number of individuals, including his own crew, the Five Elders, and Nerona Imu. He is the only known person in history to wield the powers of two Devil Fruits.

name: Sabo
status: assessing the situation after Vegapunk’s broadcast.
info: "Flame Emperor" Sabo is the Revolutionary Army's chief of staff, recognized as the No. 2 of the entire organization under Supreme Commander Monkey D. Dragon. He is also the sworn brother of the notorious pirates Monkey D. Luffy and the late Portgas D. Ace.

name: Monkey D. Dragon
status: Seeking victory before global land conflict begins
info: Monkey D. Dragon, also known as the "Rebellious Dragon", is the supreme commander and founder of the Revolutionary Army (originally the Freedom Fighters). A former Marine, his disgust with the organization's actions in the God Valley Incident, and its brutality in the Ohara Incident led to him forming the Revolutionary Army to oppose the World Government in its entirety. Having campaigned toward its downfall for over thirty years, he is labeled the "World's Worst Criminal".

name: Emporio Ivankov
status: assessing the situation after Vegapunk’s broadcast.
info: Emporio Ivankov, or Iva for short, is the queen of the Kamabakka Kingdom, known as "Okama King" and a "Miracle Person". He is one of the Revolutionary Army's founding members, as well as the commander of the G Army, which covers the Grand Line. A former slave of the World Nobles, he escaped during the Native Hunting Competition on God Valley and was responsible for the God Valley Incident along with Ginny.

name: Koala
status: assessing the situation after Vegapunk’s broadcast.
info: Koala is a high ranking officer of the Revolutionary Army, serving as the Fish-Man Karate assistant instructor. She started as a slave on Mary Geoise, but was then set free by Fisher Tiger's rampage. She sailed along with the Sun Pirates to reach her home town. Approximately two years later, she left her family to join the Revolutionary Army, where she often works alongside both Sabo and Hack.
